title: Sam Altman - How to Make an Abundant Future - [Invest Like the Best, EP.484]
summary:
## TL;DR
The podcast features an interview with Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, discussing the history, present, and future of the company. Altman reflects on the challenges faced by OpenAI in the past year, including spreading themselves too thin, and how they have refocused on developing the best and most cost-effective AI models. He also discusses the potential of AI to transform the world and the importance of making AI accessible to everyone.

## Key Themes
* The history and development of OpenAI, including the creation of ChatGPT and the company's focus on developing the best and most cost-effective AI models.
* The potential of AI to transform the world, including its ability to grant "wishes" and make people's lives better, and the importance of ensuring that AI is used for the benefit of all people.
* The challenges faced by OpenAI, including the need to secure large amounts of compute power and the potential risks and downsides of AI, such as job displacement and concentration of power.
* The importance of innovation and progress in AI, including the development of new technologies such as optical computing and the potential for automated research.
* The role of researchers and software engineers in the development of AI, and how their roles may change as AI becomes more advanced.

## VC Signals & Market Moves
* Sam Altman believes that the next 12 months will be the best for OpenAI, with significant progress in developing new AI models and products.
* Altman notes that OpenAI has secured significant compute power, including partnerships with Microsoft, Oracle, and NVIDIA, and plans to continue to invest in compute infrastructure.
* The conversation touches on the potential for AI to disrupt various industries, including healthcare, education, and entertainment, and the importance of ensuring that AI is used to benefit all people.
* Altman mentions that OpenAI is focused on developing the best and most cost-effective AI models, and plans to continue to innovate and improve its products and services.

## Notable Quotes
* "I think this will be the greatest thus far technological achievement of human history. But the only way that it really matters is if it makes people's lives much better than they otherwise would have been." — Sam Altman
* "We're about to create a genie that can grant any wish. I think it's very important that the first wishes that we, the world, ask this genie to do benefit the world as a whole." — Sam Altman
* "Concentration of power with AI is a terrifying thing. I think a lot of the talk about safety concerns is well-founded. And then a lot of it is about people that just really, even if it's slightly subconscious, want to concentrate power." — Sam Altman

## Vocabulary & Concepts to Know
* AGI: Artificial General Intelligence, referring to a hypothetical AI system that possesses the ability to understand, learn, and apply knowledge across a wide range of tasks.
* Compute: Refers to the processing power and infrastructure required to train and run AI models.
* Distillation: A process of transferring knowledge from a large AI model to a smaller one, allowing the smaller model to perform similar tasks.
* Frontier: Refers to the leading edge of AI research and development, where new breakthroughs and innovations are being made.
* Pareto optimal frontier: A concept in economics and optimization theory, referring to the set of optimal solutions that cannot be improved upon without sacrificing something else.
